Follow all instructions carefully and precisely. /bounty $800 Bounties can only be paid upon successful PR merge.

opportunities.title: Add reward_velocity_tracker() measuring the ratio of rewards claimed vs rewards accrued
opportunities.summary: ## Summary Add a velocity metric tracking how quickly rewards are being claimed relative to how quickly they are accruing. High velocity (claims keeping pace with accrual) suggests healthy engagement; low velocity suggests accumulating overhang that could create sudden sell pressure when stakers eventually claim. ## Acceptance Criteria - [ ] `VelocitySnapshot` struct: `{ accrued_this_epoch: i128, claimed_this_epoch: i128, velocity_bps: u32, snapshot_at: u32 }` - [ ] `RewardVelocityTracker` in instance storage: `{ epoch_start: u32, accrued: i128, claimed: i128 }` - [ ] `accrued` incremented in `calc_pending_reward` when reward is computed (not when claimed) - [ ] `claimed` incremented in `pay_reward` when tokens are transferred - [ ] `get_reward_velocity() -> VelocitySnapshot` public read-only query - [ ] `velocity_bps` = `claimed_this_epoch * 10000 / accrued_this_epoch` — capped at 10000 - [ ] Epoch resets every `LEDGERS_PER_DAY * 7` (weekly) automatically - [ ] `velocity_snapshot_taken` event at epoch boundary: `(velocity_bps, accrued, claimed, ledger)` - [ ] Tests: high-claim pool shows high velocity, low-claim pool shows low velocity, epoch reset clears counters, velocity capped
